facts.fact: BoFiNet CEO Geoffrey Seleka says the Digital Delta Data Centre is a carrier-neutral facility open to all licensed operators and cloud service providers, serving government, state-owned enterprises, parastatals and private companies.
BoFiNet CEO Geoffrey Seleka says the Digital Delta Data Centre is Uptime Institute Tier III certified, with 99.982 percent availability.
BoFiNet CEO Geoffrey Seleka refers to Botswana's Data Protection Act as the law in line with which customer data should reside in Botswana.

BWA.note: The residency reading is the CEO's own; no authority, regulations or application stated.

facts.fact: BoFiNet CEO Geoffrey Seleka says government has taken a strategic decision to migrate its critical services to the Digital Delta Data Centre to improve national data sovereignty.

BWA.note: Migration is a decision, not stated as completed hosting.

facts.fact: BoFiNet CEO Geoffrey Seleka describes the Digital Delta Data Centre as an open carrier-neutral facility hosting government, state-owned enterprises and private companies; the document does not state its ownership.
BoFiNet CEO Geoffrey Seleka says the Digital Delta Data Centre is Uptime Institute Tier III certified.

BWA.note: Ownership of the facility is not stated, so no owner fact.
Startups mentioned only as potential tenants; no law or fund.
